captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a commercial bar blender, consisting of a black rectangular base, a light gray cylindrical jar, and a black lid. The jar features a vertical black handle on one side and sits on a gray collar locking base. The lid has a small, light blue circular insert in the center. The assembly includes a revolute twist joint where the jar locks into the base, a revolute hinge at the edge of the lid, and a continuous rotation joint for the internal blade assembly.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a commercial bar blender. The model should feature a rectangular black base housing, a cylindrical light gray metal jar with a black handle, and a black lid with a central cap. Define a revolute joint for locking the jar onto the base, a revolute hinge for opening the lid, and a continuous rotation joint for the internal blades.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a Box primitive with a smaller gray plate on top. Model the jar as a Cylinder combined with a smaller base collar and a handle built from extruded rectangular profiles. Create the lid as a thin Cylinder with a small central cap. Use the custom framework to define parts for the base, jar, lid, and blades, linking them with revolute and continuous joints at their respective pivot origins.
